verdicts.human_summary: Announcement assertions should be wrapped in waitFor because announce() from @react-aria/live-announcer schedules DOM updates asynchronously, causing potential intermittent test failures

@react-aria/live-announcer should be added to code/addons/vitest/package.json since it's imported at runtime in vitest addon files but only declared in core's package.json, which can break in strict workspace installs
